categories.title: Features
list: Adds "Modded Entity (Remap Texture)" to File > Convert Project.
Packs all cubes into a new box UV texture and copies the pixels of every face, including flipped and rotated face UVs.
Turns overlay cubes into a smaller cube with inflate instead of resampling them.
Rounds non integer cube sizes up and compensates with inflate.
Checks every pixel after the conversion and reports resampled faces and geometry changes.
